lines.trans: The network director sees clearly that the other units are worlds apart from Unit One.
What a top-tier television network values most is programme quality.
So the director ordered everyone in Unit Two out and formally handed the talk show to Unit One.
The director also wants our boss to step in and take over the show completely.
For all of my staff, overtime hours have already hit the absolute limit.
I cannot spare any extra time myself right now either.
We simply cannot juggle extra production projects beyond what was agreed.
The director already had his assistant call to schedule a talk with the chairwoman.
For Mr Sun to cause a scene like that in the meeting really crossed the line.
Let us not tell anyone else about this incident yet.
Does anyone even need us to tell them?
We worry about him losing face while he could not care less — worse embarrassment lies ahead.
